## Company

ELFA Electric sells electric motorcycles and scooties in Pakistan. Positioning: zero emissions, lower running cost, instant torque, quiet operation, LiFePO4 batteries, and after-sales support.

Office: C3i GA-70-A3, Korangi Creek Industrial Park, Korangi, Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan.
WhatsApp: +(92) 311-486-3532
Phone: 021-37173532
Email: info@elfaelectric.com

## Products

### ELFA EV-125 (electric bike)

Page: https://elfaelectric.com/ev-125
Buy: https://elfaelectric.com/product/elfaev125

- Limited-time offer: list PKR 345,000, current PKR 335,000 + tax (about Rs. 3,350 tax noted on the product page).
- Motor: 2,000 W
- Top speed: up to 75 km/h
- Range: 100+ km per charge (Eco mode; varies with speed, load, and tyre pressure)
- Battery: 72V/30Ah lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4)
- Features called out on the site: digital dashboard, app connectivity, tubeless tyres, speed modes (Eco, City, Sports)
- Battery warranty commonly stated as 3 years or 50,000 km, whichever comes first (see FAQs and warranty booklet)
- Colors on the purchase page: black, red, silver

### EV-1 Scooty

Page: https://elfaelectric.com/scooty-ev-1
Buy: https://elfaelectric.com/product/ev1-scooty

- Limited-time offer: list PKR 270,000, current PKR 260,000 + tax (about Rs. 2,600 tax noted on the product page).
- Motor: 1,500 W
- Top speed: up to 60 km/h
- Range: about 75 km (site also mentions roughly 70–80 km depending on mode, weight, and terrain)
- Battery: lithium iron phosphate; product marketing cites 64V/30Ah on the prices page and a 60V figure in some scooty meta copy — confirm on the live product page before quoting a voltage
- Features: LED display, mobile app, water-resistant battery (not submersible), speed modes
- Weight cited in FAQs: about 100 kg
- Charge time cited in FAQs: about 3 hours with the included charger

### Price list

https://elfaelectric.com/electric-bike-prices

2026 list published on that page:
- ELFA EV125: PKR 345,000 struck through, PKR 335,000 + tax
- EV-1 Scooty: PKR 270,000 struck through, PKR 260,000 + tax
- Copy states prices include a 3-year battery warranty and after-sales support, with no hidden charges
- Running-cost claim on that page: travel up to 1 km in about 1 rupee

## Financing

https://elfaelectric.com/financing-partners
https://elfaelectric.com/installment-plans
https://elfaelectric.com/scooty-instalment

Partners named on the site: Asaan Ghar, Qist Baazar, WASL, and TMF (Thardeep Microfinance Foundation). The prices page also mentions SOLARIZE.

The financing page includes a payment calculator. Plan amounts differ by provider, term (commonly 6–24 months), and for TMF by “with advance” vs “without advance”. Quote calculator output from the live page rather than memorizing a single monthly figure.

The prices page says monthly installments can start from about PKR 10,500/month. That is a marketing floor, not every plan.

## PAVE

https://elfaelectric.com/pave-scheme

Pre-booking for a government subsidy. Marketing states Rs. 80,000 government subsidy. Both EV-125 and EV-1 are described as PAVE eligible on the site. Confirm current eligibility and amount on the live page.

## Referral

https://elfaelectric.com/referral

Referral program: PKR 10,000 when a referred person purchases an ELFA EV-125. Terms on the page include payout timing, that it may not combine with other offers, and that EV Technologies may verify transactions.
